railwayCli.note: Every command above was read from `railway <command> --help` of the pinned version rather than recalled. The CLI is not an npm dependency of this repository; see the //dependencies note in the root package.json for why. scripts/railway/lib/cli.ts resolves it from RAILWAY_CLI_BIN, then a `railway` on PATH whose --version matches, then `npx --yes @railway/cli@<version>`.

railwaySdk.purpose: Provides `railway/iac` for .railway/railway.ts and the `railway-iac-ts` runner the CLI shells out to. Taken as a devDependency because the IaC file imports it and must type-check against it.

node.note: Matches portfolio/package.json engines and both existing CI workflows.

lighthouse.purpose: Performance, accessibility, best-practices and SEO audit of the DEPLOYED site. Invoked through npx rather than taken as a dependency, for the same reason as the Railway CLI: it is a tool this repository runs, not a library it links, and it brings a large transitive tree that would sit in a lockfile for the sake of one occasional command.
lighthouse.chromiumSource: The Chromium that Playwright already installs for the browser suites. No second browser download.
